headline: Late Natalie Collins Goal Earns Filipinas 1-1 Draw With Uzbekistan
seoTitle: Natalie Collins Saves Filipinas With Late Equalizer vs Uzbekistan | FMB News
seoDescription: Teenage debutant Natalie Collins scored in the 89th minute as the Filipinas opened their Asian Games campaign with a 1-1 draw against Uzbekistan.
deck: Nineteen-year-old Natalie Collins scored seven minutes after entering on her senior international debut, preserving a point for the Philippines in its Group G opener.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine women’s national football team opened its Asian Games campaign with a 1-1 draw against Uzbekistan.
Uzbekistan took the lead in the 81st minute before 19-year-old Natalie Collins, who entered as a substitute in the 82nd minute on her senior international debut, scored the equalizer in the 89th.
The result gave both teams one point in Group G.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The Filipinas next face Hong Kong before completing the group stage against host China.
Under the tournament format, the top two teams in each group plus the two best third-place finishers advance to the quarterfinals.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The late goal prevented an opening defeat and kept the Philippines firmly in the qualification race.
Collins’ immediate impact also adds a new young option to a national team continuing to deepen its player pool after recent major-tournament appearances.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Filipinas’ next match against Hong Kong, where a victory would materially improve their path to the knockout stage, followed by the group finale against China.

verificationNotes: The 1-1 score, 81st-minute Uzbekistan goal, Collins’ 82nd-minute substitution and 89th-minute equalizer were corroborated by the Olympic Council of Asia and GMA News.
The article states the advancement format without projecting a qualification outcome.
